TRI_CENTERS = {'B','C','N','P','As','Sb','Bi','Ge','Sn','Se','Te','I','S','Ga'}  # potential planar/pyramidal

def triangle_normals(s, center_els=None):
    results = []
    for i, site in enumerate(s):
        el = site.specie.symbol
        if center_els and el not in center_els:
            continue
        nn = mdnn.get_nn_info(s, i)
        # keep only anion-like neighbors
        an_nn = [n for n in nn if n['site'].specie.symbol in {'S','Se','Te','O','N','Cl','Br','I','P','As','F'}]
        if len(an_nn) < 3:
            continue
        # take 3 shortest
        an_nn = sorted(an_nn, key=lambda n: np.linalg.norm(n['site'].coords-site.coords))[:3]
        vecs = [n['site'].coords - site.coords for n in an_nn]
        # planarity: volume of tetra / or scalar triple
        v0,v1,v2 = vecs
        triple = abs(np.dot(v0, np.cross(v1,v2)))
        # area
        nrm = np.cross(v1-v0, v2-v0)
        area = np.linalg.norm(nrm)
        if area < 1e-6:
            continue
        normal = nrm / area
        # pyramid height: projection of centroid of ligands onto normal from center
        cent = (v0+v1+v2)/3
        height = abs(np.dot(cent, normal))
        results.append({
            'i': i, 'el': el, 'cn_an': len(an_nn),
            'ds': [round(np.linalg.norm(v),3) for v in vecs],
            'height': round(height,3),
            'normal': np.round(normal,3),
            'ligs': [n['site'].specie.symbol for n in an_nn],

def alignment_order(normals):
    if len(normals)<1:
        return 0, None
    # nematic order S = (3/2)<(n·d)^2> - 1/2, find best d
    N = np.array(normals)
    # Q tensor
    Q = np.zeros((3,3))
    for n in N:
        Q += np.outer(n,n)
    Q /= len(N)
    evals, evecs = np.linalg.eigh(Q)
    # max eigenvalue 1 if all parallel, 1/3 if random
    return float(evals[-1]), evecs[:,-1]
